check.comparison: the GNN stack vs k5_rf5 + MWWk at the same DrawKeys
check.floor: M5's floors rule (producer_read.pilot_reading: max(the atlas-spread floor at the read's counts, own 3 SE), the n = 1 rule); atlas spreads from the registered atlas v2
check.rule: faithful if g_imit >= -F_imit (M5's floors rule on the 16 monitor world-episodes at replicates 0 / 1) and the imitated stack has no more deaths than k5_rf5 + MWWk; else short (stop: the user hears it before any RL)
check.swap_reading: each swap arm - k5_rf5 + MWWk with the same floor rule; deaths; reported, never gating

labels.orderer: MWW's normalised makeable weights over the eligible producers per order slot; slots with one eligible producer dropped
labels.producer: k5_rf5's raw action: 3 toggles (raw > 0) and per input row the replenish fraction raw / BOUND

samples.reuse: EXP-0099's collected samples (v1 collect), only at these SHA-256s; else a v2 collect

training.world_episodes: the 128 training world-episodes minus the 16 monitor ones (112), replicate 0

decisions: notes/user-decisions.md (2026-11-06): fully learned, from imitation; the user hears a `short` reading before any RL

fit.hogwild: v1's fit (shared weights, a shard and an Adam per process) plus per-step clipping; not bit-reproducible
fit.mode_rule: auto: before the fit, one epoch of each mode on the full training samples (hogwild first, then sync; fresh models, the same seed); sync if its epoch costs <= sync_max_cost x hogwild's, else hogwild (with clipping); the mode and both times recorded in spec.json
fit.stopping_rule: fixed 20 epochs (no early stopping); the checkpoint SHA-256 is the pinned artifact
fit.sync: synchronous data parallel: per step each worker's shard-mean gradient, averaged in worker order, clipped to the global norm, one Adam step; deterministic

model.losses: BCE (toggles) + Huber delta 0.1 (replenish fractions, masked) + KL (orderer slots)

normaliser.fitted_on: every k-th training decision per actor, k = ceil(n / norm_decisions); stored in the checkpoint
normaliser.transform: signed log1p on the registered count columns

reported.also: units of both stacks and deaths
reported.on: the training and the monitor episodes' labels

status: frozen before EXP-0100's data; real collect / fit / check refuse any other file
